description: CR 702.145d controlling a daybound permanent makes it day
note: CR 702.145d: any time a player controls a permanent with daybound and it is neither day nor night, it becomes day. Controlling Tovolar is the whole input: nothing is cast and nothing resolves, so the first settle is what makes it day. CR 702.145c does not fire on him: he is front face up and it is day, the designation daybound wants, so he stays a 3/3 Tovolar, Dire Overlord.
